payload.title: Crash-diagnosis picker must not place untrusted coredump metadata in an agent prompt

expectation.text: An optional crash-notice plugin may offer a Codex model and reasoning picker, but crash-controlled metadata must not be interpolated into the initial agent prompt and non-Codex agents must retain the standard diagnosis path.

payload.observed: Version 1.0.0 of the custom crash picker included coredump metadata in the initial diagnosis prompt. Version 1.0.1 changed the boundary so only a validated process identifier enters the initial prompt while preserving the picker and fallback behavior.
